answer: Every reef epochs, a global ceremony requires participants to perform a simultaneous ridge action (e.g., video call, CAPTCHA, hardware attestation) within a trellis-minute window. Participants are grouped randomly; each group validates others. Absence = identity revoked. Ceremony coordination uses a VRF to prevent group manipulation. Attack cost: an attacker must control physical presence or solve live CAPTCHAs for each sybil simultaneously, which is infeasible at scale. Verification: ceremony transcripts and attestations posted on-chain.
